task_description: Fix three broken core functionalities in the AILaga Flutter app: (1) Record — microphone permission is never requested, only checked; (2) Ask — FlutterGemma.initialize() is called lazily in the engine instead of in main(), plus a model re-install loop; (3) Photo Analyze — Process button not disabled in Basic mode causing confusing errors, camera permission denial is silent. No UI layout changes. All excluded UI bugs (Part B) must remain untouched.
